info.title: Humanize daemon
info.description: The methods an hmz daemon serves over a session of protocol/wire.md. Parameters are by name; a parameter a method does not list is refused. protocol/daemon.md states what each method does. Server-to-client notifications are listed under x-notifications.

methods.name: session.hello
methods.summary: Open the session: say the client's protocol and name.

methods.name: session.cancel
methods.summary: Ask the daemon to give up a call (a notification; never answered).

methods.name: pair.claim
methods.summary: Pair this session's device with a token of a pairing code.

methods.name: devices.revoke
methods.summary: Revoke a paired device and close its sessions.

methods.name: hosts.running
methods.summary: Every host whose epic is going or stopping.

methods.name: hosts.open
methods.summary: Start the host of a workspace and slot, without attaching.

methods.name: hosts.detach
methods.summary: Let every frontend of a host go.

methods.name: epic.attach
methods.summary: Attach to a host as one frontend; opens an epic subscription.

methods.name: epic.start
methods.summary: Start an epic on the host.

methods.name: epic.afk
methods.summary: Set a role, or every role, away or back.

methods.name: epic.claim
methods.summary: Claim a role for this frontend.

methods.name: epic.board
methods.summary: Write or remove a line of the board.

methods.name: epic.aside
methods.summary: Open, ask or answer a side conversation of this frontend.

methods.name: env.list
methods.summary: List a directory of an environment.

methods.name: env.stat
methods.summary: Say what one path of an environment is.

methods.name: env.read
methods.summary: Read a file of an environment.

methods.name: env.find
methods.summary: List the files of an environment, to open one by its name.

methods.name: env.search
methods.summary: Search the files of an environment for text.

methods.name: env.write
methods.summary: Write a file of an environment.

methods.name: env.mkdir
methods.summary: Make a directory of an environment, with its parents.

methods.name: env.rename
methods.summary: Move a path of an environment.

methods.name: env.remove
methods.summary: Remove a path of an environment, and everything under it.

methods.name: env.term.open
methods.summary: Open a terminal in an environment, or attach to one again.

methods.name: env.term.ack
methods.summary: Say how many more bytes of a terminal's output this frontend drew.

methods.name: env.git.status
methods.summary: The git status of an environment.

methods.name: env.git.diff
methods.summary: Both sides of one file's change.

methods.name: env.git.log
methods.summary: The latest commits of an environment.

methods.name: env.git.discard
methods.summary: Throw away the worktree's changes to paths.

methods.name: env.git.rewind
methods.summary: Rewind an environment to a snapshot.

methods.name: btw.list
methods.summary: The side conversations about an epic.

methods.name: runs.span
methods.summary: One span of the last timeline laid out.

methods.name: runs.bundle
methods.summary: Write an epic's .hmzepic and give a read handle of it.

methods.name: runs.import
methods.summary: Import an archive from a write handle or a path.

methods.name: backups.epics
methods.summary: The epics a backup target holds.

methods.name: backups.pull
methods.summary: Download an epic from a backup target.

methods.name: files.write
methods.summary: Append a chunk to a write handle.

methods.name: files.read
methods.summary: Read a chunk of a read handle.

methods.name: flows.list
methods.summary: The flows on offer in a workspace.

methods.name: flows.backends
methods.summary: The CLIs installed, their accounts and models.

methods.name: flows.setup
methods.summary: Write what a workspace runs a flow with.

methods.name: flows.check
methods.summary: Check the epic a flow and its set-up make, without starting it.

methods.name: flows.fork
methods.summary: Copy a flow into the workspace.

methods.name: workspaces.add
methods.summary: Write a workspace in the settings.

methods.name: workspaces.forget
methods.summary: Forget what a workspace was set up with.

methods.name: flowverses.remove
methods.summary: Remove a flowverse and what was installed from it.

methods.name: flowverses.install
methods.summary: Install a release of a flow.

methods.name: paths.complete
methods.summary: Complete a typed path to directories.

methods.name: settings.get
methods.summary: The settings of the daemon's machine, and of a workspace.

methods.name: settings.forget
methods.summary: Forget what a workspace was set up with.

methods.name: accounts.models
methods.summary: Ask a CLI what it runs as an account.

methods.name: accounts.copy
methods.summary: Copy an account to another CLI.

methods.name: runtimes.check
methods.summary: Reach a runtime and say what it has.

methods.name: runtimes.hosts
methods.summary: The hosts of the ssh configuration.

methods.name: runtimes.import
methods.summary: Save an ssh runtime per host.

methods.name: notices.list
methods.summary: The notices kept after an id.

Workspace.description: An absolute path of the daemon's machine, ~ expanded there.

Slot.description: "" for the workspace's own host, chat:<hex> or exec:<hex>.

Listener.description: A listener spec of Section 3.9.2 of [DAEMON].

EnvId.description: An environment of the host, as the envs snapshot names it (Section 4.24.2 of [DAEMON]).

EnvPath.description: A path relative to the environment's workdir, or an absolute POSIX path.

TermId.description: A terminal of the host (Section 4.24.4 of [DAEMON]).

Env.description: One environment of the envs snapshot (Section 4.24.2 of [DAEMON]).

EnvEntry.description: One path of an environment (Section 4.24.3 of [DAEMON]).

InvalidRequest.message: Not a JSON-RPC 2.0 request, a batch, or a call before session.hello.

InvalidParams.message: Parameters not as this document states.

NotPaired.message: This device is not paired: claim a pairing code first.

NotFound.message: What the call names does not exist.

Conflict.message: Refused in the state things are in, a host's refusal included.

TooLarge.message: More than a call or an answer here may carry.

Upstream.message: A program or service the daemon asked did not answer.

Unavailable.message: What the call needs cannot be reached now.

x-notifications.name: epic.event
x-notifications.summary: One message of an epic subscription (Section 4.9 of [DAEMON]).

x-notifications.name: notices.event
x-notifications.summary: One notice of a notices subscription, or its end where it fell behind.
